tools.name: capture_website
tools.description: Capture desktop, mobile, or both screenshots for a website. Successful screenshots are reused from cache until TTL expiry; failed or blocked captures are never cached and are retried live on the next call.

tools.name: read_page_context
tools.description: Render a public web page and return a compact Community agent-readable representation: visible text, clean Markdown, headings, links, forms, basic image metadata and interactive elements with bounding boxes. No OCR, visual inference, crawl, sessions or advanced action selectors.
